stage: Q3 bounded retrospective robustness and visible crossing

state_slice.measure: nanoseconds elapsed between the first and last state in the same 32-event causal window
state_slice.threshold: per-stock median on the same Jan-March sampled training endpoints as Q2
state_slice.high_activity: duration strictly below the frozen training median
state_slice.low_activity: duration greater than or equal to the frozen training median
state_slice.undefined: zero/negative duration or fewer than three scored rows in a stock/day/slice

updated_models.comparison: updated and fixed models evaluated on identical original-event rows in each month

execution.entry: visible ask for long or bid for short at t
execution.exit: opposite visible quote at original event t+20 in same stock/day/segment
execution.unit: one share for each selected opportunity, zero delay, no impact/fees/inventory model
execution.primary_sequence_action: arithmetic mean of three fixed GRU seed predictions
execution.common_opportunity: same Q2 scoring event IDs with finite current and t+20 spread and midpoint label
execution.outputs: per-stock/day opportunity counts, each model coverage, selected gross midpoint movement, entry/exit half-spread, visible crossed markout; common-selected sensitivity

lo_so: not run unless source-only inner chronological tuning and remaining compute budget are established
exposure: all evaluation dates previously inspected; descriptive only
